text:
Priya: Heads up — planning a webinar next Tues aimed at PLG activation. Need alignment on launch posts, benchmark narrative, prompt template pack + starter credits, inbound routing, and the activation nudge flow. Who's on?
Tom: I can take launch posts + social. Will draft 3 variants (use-case, benchmark, short demo). ETA Wed.
Maya: I'll own the prompt templates & promptpack. Thinking 5 starter templates: summarize, rewrite, codegen assistant, brainstorm, cold-email.
Eli: Routing side — propose: webinar signups with product_usage_last_7d >= 2 -> sales queue; others -> automated onboarding drip with credits.
Priya: For credits, recommend a 2k token starter bundle tied to the webinar CTA. Any objections?
Maya: 2k fine, but add per-day rate limit (10/day) and flagged abuse detection.
Tom: For launch posts let's A/B test two benchmark narratives: 1) productivity uplift story, 2) latency/cost narrative with sample numbers.
Eli: Can we tag inbound leads with a cohort flag like webinar_promptpack_interest so we can measure funnel separately?
ops-bot: Reminder: marketing links should include utm params + internal param: ?src=webinar_q2&mk_campaign=webinar_promptpack
Priya: We need a tracking spec: GA events + user trait in internal DB. Who can draft?
Devon: I'll do the tracking spec and PR it today. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Also need a small probe eval for the promptpack across 3 benchmarks: summarization quality, code assistant correctness, instruction-following. Can run on our eval harness.
Tom: Webinar slide CTA -> claim promptpack + credits. CTA link must pre-fill email if logged in and include tag.
Eli: Routing pseudo for ops:
if (signup.source == 'webinar' && product_usage_last_7d >= 2) {
  route = 'sales-high-touch'
} else {
  route = 'auto-nudge'
}
We should also add a short TTL for the high-touch tag (14 days).
Priya: Success metrics: 7-day activation = >=1 API key use AND >=3 calls. Target 15% activation from webinar cohort. Also track median time-to-first-call.
Tom: Creative checklist: 2 hero images, 1 benchmark chart, 3 social copy variations. I'll coordinate with design.
Maya: Promptpack quickstart snippet (for slide + docs):
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
 -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-1", "prompt": "Summarize: {{text}}", "max_tokens": 200}'
I'll include 3 example prompts per template in the pack.
Eli: I'll add experiment flag: webinar_q2_v1 and set cohort tag on signup. Will also wire rule in routing service.
Priya: Good. Can we get a quick timeline?
Tom: Draft social + landing copy Wed. Design assets Thu morning. Final slides + CTA Thurs EOD.
Maya: Promptpack + docs ready by Thurs midday. Eval results Thu afternoon.
Devon: Tracking spec PR by tomorrow EOD, will include event names: webinar_signup, promptpack_claim, credits_redeemed, first_api_call.
Priya: Awesome. Calendar: Friday 10am final signoff. Please add anything I'm missing.
Tom: I'll also schedule the A/B test for benchmark messaging across email + LinkedIn.
Maya: Need a short how-to video (2 min) showing promptpack in action — can do a screencast.
Eli: One more ask: add property "lead_score_at_signup" to help prioritize sales routing.
Priya: Noted. Thanks team.
ops-bot: deploy reminder — marketing landing deploy scheduled 2024-05-09T14:00:00Z
Tom: :thumbsup:
Maya: added to calendar
Devon: PR opened for tracking spec: https://example.com/pr/123 (placeholder)
Priya: See you Friday 10am — we'll review final assets + routing rules.
